newsitem.title: USA: Magal Security Systems letter of intent.
newsitem.headline: Magal Security Systems letter of intent.

text.p: Magal Security Systems Ltd said on Tuesday that on December 24, 1996 Magal and Daimler-Benz Aerospace Luft-und Raumfahrt Holding AG, a wholly-owned subsidiary of Daimler-Benz AG, entered into a letter of intent.
The letter concerned the proposed purchase by Magal from Daimler-Benz of all the outstanding shares of Senstar Corporation, a wholly-owned Canadian subsidiary of Daimler-Benz.
The letter of intent also contemplates the acquisition by Magal of the security systems business of Dornier GmbH that is also owned by Daimler-Benz Aerospace AG.
The total purchase price payable for such shares and business is approximately $5.1 million.
Consummation of the acquisitions contemplated by the letter of intent is subject to the execution and delivery of a definitive Share and Asset Purchase Agreement.
It is contemplated that such consummation will take place in February 1997.
Magal develops, manufactures and markets computerized security systems.
